summary.text: Peggy Bennett is a Republican who represents District 23A in the Minnesota House of Representatives and was first elected in 2014.

Her official House page lists committee assignments including Education Policy, Education Finance, Veterans and Military Affairs Division, and Ethics, and gives her occupation as retired educator, with a B.S. in education from Crown College and an M.S. in special education from St. Cloud State University.

sources.title: Rep. Peggy Bennett (23A) - Minnesota House of Representatives
